name: Stream Monsters
description: Portrait Arcade Rally with a 90-second fresh default, bilingual overlay guidance, a 74/26 TikTok-safe arena, K.O.-only Rules v8 battles, Arena Collapse, element-specific WebGPU effects, 72 bundled Furry forms, and fair permanent progression.
author: Pup Cid

descriptions.en: Portrait Arcade Rally with a 90-second fresh default, bilingual overlay guidance, a 74/26 TikTok-safe arena, K.O.-only Rules v8 battles, Arena Collapse, element-specific WebGPU effects, 72 bundled Furry forms, and fair permanent progression.
descriptions.de: Portrait Arcade Rally mit 90-Sekunden-Standard für neue Setups, zweisprachigen Overlay-Hinweisen, 74/26-TikTok-Safe-Arena, K.-o.-Kämpfen nach Rules v8, Arena Collapse, elementspezifischen WebGPU-Effekten, 72 gebündelten Furry-Formen und fairem permanentem Fortschritt.
descriptions.es: Portrait Arcade Rally con 90 segundos por defecto en configuraciones nuevas, guía bilingüe, arena 74/26 segura para TikTok, combates Rules v8 hasta K.O., Arena Collapse, efectos WebGPU elementales, 72 formas Furry y progreso permanente justo.
descriptions.fr: Portrait Arcade Rally avec 90 secondes par défaut pour les nouvelles configurations, guide bilingue, arène TikTok 74/26, combats Rules v8 jusqu’au K.-O., Arena Collapse, effets WebGPU élémentaires, 72 formes Furry et progression permanente équitable.
